'''A stone bowl'''{{Sic}} is a [[quest items|quest item]] used only in [[Elemental Workshop I]]. It is found by searching the [[Boxes (Elemental Workshop)|boxes]] north-east of the hatch in the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|Elemental Workshop]].

It is used to make '''a stone bowl''' filled with lava from a [[lava trough]]. The full stone bowl is then used on the [[Furnace (Elemental Workshop)|furnace]] to heat it up.

Duplicates can be [[drop trick]]ed by searching the boxes to obtain another.

A stone bowl[sic] is a quest item used only in Elemental Workshop I. It is found by searching the boxes north-east of the hatch in the Elemental Workshop.

It is used to make a stone bowl filled with lava from a lava trough. The full stone bowl is then used on the furnace to heat it up.

Duplicates can be drop tricked by searching the boxes to obtain another.
